entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语词头作 "poco secreto / Hablador"，义指不守秘密、多嘴。
entries.en: 〔original damaged; sense uncertain〕 headword 'poco secreto / Hablador': not good at keeping a secret; talkative.
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆空，仅存西语词头，且 "de cùr." 疑为参见他条之残字，无从与汉栏互证。

entries.en: not long; a short while; soon
an instant; in a flash

entries.zh: 瞬息之间；极短的时间内
entries.en: in an instant; within a moment

entries.zh: 微不足道；无关紧要（卑微不足道）
entries.en: of little importance; trifling; insignificant
a trivial matter; a small affair

entries.zh: 无甚要紧的事；不值一提的事
entries.en: no great matter; nothing of consequence
entries.notes: H 栏有 [疑:勝/甚]，M 栏 lah 字难定，暂按"无甚要紧事"一路释义。

entries.en: an idle matter; other people's business; a matter of no importance
only just; barely; scarcely
entries.notes: L 栏 "poco falso" 疑为 "poco falto"（几近），H 僅有与 M "quīn ū" 相合，惟末字 "gū̃" 未能解。

entries.en: almost; nearly; not far off; more or less the same
timid; of little courage or judgement
faint-hearted; having little courage and prudence
very few; extremely little; next to none
entries.notes: L 栏 "despo~" 截断，西语原义不可核，据 H 絕少／M "cheāt siáu" 定为"极少"。

entries.en: more or less; roughly; about
no need; it does not matter; not necessary
young age; childhood; of few years

entries.zh: 少许；略有一些（犹言极少）
entries.en: a little; very little; slightly
entries.notes: H "頗潦" 非通行词，M "pǒ liàu" 亦难对，暂依 L "muy poco" 释"很少"。

entries.zh: 近乎有理；勉强说得过去
entries.en: barely reasonable; little short of right
entries.notes: L "Poca razon tiene"（谓其理据不足）与 H "近道理" 语气相左，此处从汉栏直释，西语原意并记。

entries.en: rare; seldom; few and far between
well; deep well
entries.notes: L 栏讹拼（"Poco- al poriondo"），疑为 poço fundo「深井」，与 H 井、R "cìm" 相合。

entries.en: shallow well; of little depth
